text: {"lessons":["I should not treat recent price moves as forecasts; these prices move randomly, so I need a disciplined plan rather than reacting to short-term changes.","I should judge each holding by its future risk and prospects, not cling to it just to avoid admitting a purchase was a mistake.","I should keep diversification and my overall portfolio risk in view, and trade only when a deliberate rebalancing decision warrants it."]}
